title: Jab hua farqe mubarak khoon se tar Abbas ka
body:
Jab hua farqe mubarak khoo'n me tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Hogaya ranj o alam se shaq jigar Abbas(a.s) ka
1. Saath paani ke labe darya baha khoone jar
tukde tukde kardiya zalim ne sar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Jab hua farqe mubarak khoo'n me tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. kehti thi baali Sakina(s.a) phir na zindaa'n ka ho gham
zikr gar sunti rahu'n shaam o sahar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Jab hua farqe mubarak khoo'n me tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khoon ki bhi naher ek reti pa jaari hogayi
Ek baazu kat gaya jab naher par Abbas(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Jab hua farqe mubarak khoo'n me tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shah ke rone ki sada sunkar yeh Zainab(s.a) ne kaha
hogaya shaayad zamaane se safar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Jab hua farqe mubarak khoo'n me tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ek ba ek Aakar laga mashke sakina(s.a) par jo teer
Saath pani ke baha khoone jigar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Jab hua farqe mubarak khoo'n me tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Le rahi thi shouq se kar gaam par bose zamee'n
Ho raha tha farqe anwar khoo'n se tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Jab hua farqe mubarak khoo'n me tar Abbas(a.s) ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Janab Syed Sarfaraz Ali Razvi Sahab Qibla
